prompt_record.text: Create a single original friendly no-search-results illustration for Local Asset Studio, matching the provided frame-and-folio illustration's restrained ivory paper, graphite outlines, subtle pale cyan accents, careful hand-drawn shading and professional quiet mood. Use reference as style only; replace subject with TWO small offset empty rectangular search frames, with a clearly visible quiet gap separating them. One frame slightly front left, other back right, neither containing a picture. A small understated magnifying-glass rim may be incorporated in one corner to make searching legible, but no punctuation or warning symbols. Complete isolated object group on genuinely transparent background. Landscape 3:2, generous clear margins, reads at 384x256. No background, tabletop, glow, checkerboard, vignette, lettering, buttons, arrows, crosses, checkmarks, progress indicators, face or mascot. No-results without blame or alarm. Preserve clean precise edges and actual transparency.
